yt.intro: Jackie has one of the biggest Youtube Channels for learning English, @AskJackie. She also posts English tips through her Instagram account. Today, we'll take a look at a part of her video about QUICK TIPS for Learning English. This video is the compilation of small videos she recorded for Instagram.

video.instrucao: Some of the tips are simple, others can be surprising. Pay attention to at least 1 new thing you learned.

discussao: Which tip was new for you?
Which tip(s) were you already familiar with?
What about the words FUNCTION and PRODUCTION, were you used to speaking them correctly?
conversa: Is Youtube a good source for studying English?
Some people say that Youtube may have great videos for studying English, but it is also very distracting. What's your opinion about this?
Do you know any other Youtubers that teach English?
Can social media (such as Instagram) be used to study?
If you could teach people through Youtube, what would you teach? Why?

pratica.instrucao: Repeat the words after the teacher
Choose the best alternative. (questões em jogo)

jogo.q: A: I can't believe I'm ____ ___ John! | B: I know! He is a very nice guy.
A: OMG girl, I miss you so much! | B: Yeah! We should meet and ____ __.
A: What did you do last year? | B: __ __ ____, I worked as a teacher.

avaliacao: What did you like about today's activity?
